# Vanilla & Somethin'

> Vanilla & Somethin' is an independent architecture and interior design studio based in Mangalore, Karnataka, India. The studio works across architectural design, interior design, landscape concepts, BIM and digital design, architectural visualisation and project support.

This file is supplementary machine-readable site navigation. It is not a substitute for the public HTML pages, and it is not a Google ranking signal. Use the linked pages as the canonical source for current project and service details.

## Studio and services

- [Homepage](https://www.vanillasometh.in/): Overview of the studio, its approach and selected work.
- [Architecture and interior design](https://www.vanillasometh.in/seo): Studio-wide service overview, residential and commercial design, NRI enquiries, project cost planning and regional coverage.
- [Commercial architecture and interiors](https://www.vanillasometh.in/commercial-design/): Commercial buildings, cafes, restaurants, kiosks, showrooms, retail stores, supermarkets, offices and workplace design.
- [Landscape design](https://www.vanillasometh.in/landscape-design/): Gardens, courtyards, terraces, rooftop landscapes, planting, hardscape and outdoor spaces.
- [AI-integrated project management](https://www.vanillasometh.in/project-management/): AI-integrated workflows and in-house dashboards for project milestones, progress updates, approvals and budget tracking.
- [Home renovation and short-stay design](https://www.vanillasometh.in/renovation-and-short-stay-design/): Existing-home renovation, Airbnb-style short stays, homestays, holiday homes and serviced villas.
- [Building permits and licensing support](https://www.vanillasometh.in/permits-and-licensing-support/): Design documentation and coordination for K-SMART, local authority building permissions, commercial fit-outs and relevant licensing processes.
- [Team](https://www.vanillasometh.in/team.html): Studio leadership and team.
- [Contact](https://www.vanillasometh.in/contact/): Project enquiry form and contact details.
- [Home Project Clarity Consultation](https://www.vanillasometh.in/home-project-clarity-consultation/): Paid first-step consultation for homeowners to clarify requirements, preliminary scope, budget drivers and next steps before committing to a full design engagement.
- [House construction cost in Karnataka](https://www.vanillasometh.in/house-construction-cost-karnataka/): 2026 planning guide to construction cost per square foot, example budgets, scope inclusions and exclusions for Mangaluru and Karnataka.
- [Interior design cost in Karnataka](https://www.vanillasometh.in/interior-design-cost-karnataka/): 2026 guide to full-home interior budgets, modular kitchen, wardrobe and ceiling cost measurement bases.
- [Architect vs engineer vs contractor](https://www.vanillasometh.in/architect-engineer-contractor-roles/): Who does what on a home project in India, responsibilities, deliverables and questions to ask before appointing anyone.
- [How to compare construction quotations](https://www.vanillasometh.in/compare-construction-quotations/): Guide to comparing contractor quotations by scope, specification and exclusions, with a free in-browser comparison worksheet.
- [Home budget allocation](https://www.vanillasometh.in/home-budget-allocation/): Illustrative scenarios for splitting a home budget between construction, interiors, fees and contingency.
- [Home renovation planning checklist](https://www.vanillasometh.in/home-renovation-planning-checklist/): Printable checklist for assessing, scoping, budgeting and sequencing a home renovation.
- [Architect fees in Karnataka](https://www.vanillasometh.in/architect-fees-karnataka/): How architecture fees are structured, what each design stage should deliver and how to compare fee proposals.
- [Duplex and rental-unit home design](https://www.vanillasometh.in/duplex-rental-home-design/): Feasibility, layout and lifecycle-cost considerations for homes with rental units.
- [Project Cost Estimator](https://www.vanillasometh.in/estimator/): Interactive preliminary construction/interiors cost estimator for residential, commercial and mixed-use projects, plus a separate architect-fee calculator. Results are indicative planning references, not quotations or BOQs.

- [NRI home design](https://www.vanillasometh.in/nri-home-design/): Remote-first initial design briefing and project-scope information for NRI families planning homes in India.

## Accuracy notes

The studio is based in Mangalore. A regional landing page indicates project enquiry coverage, not a staffed branch or registered office in that location. Travel, site visits and scope are agreed per project. Project locations above reflect the portfolio's own project records.
